title: On Repeat
author: Sarah Willson
description:
JUNE 2026, LOS ANGELES

you worked late again. dinner was a leftover conference bagel on the drive home. at least the traffic wasn't so bad today.

someone linked to an album release livestream at 9pm. you were caught by surprise.

this album is what you didn't know you were missing.

you forgot it was possible. love at first spin.
